selection.edition: international ImageKit Digital Asset Management API
selection.ownership: ImageKit.io, New Delhi, India (founders Rahul Nanwani, Manu Chaudhary, Somesh Khatkar). Global DAM/media API at api.imagekit.io, not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official ImageKit HTTP Basic private-key auth, GET /v1/files, GET /v1/files/{fileId}/details, GET /v1/files/{fileId}/metadata, New Delhi operator identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved ImageKit compromise found. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international ImageKit Digital Asset Management API
research.searchCoverage: Official ImageKit API documents HTTPS host https://api.imagekit.io and HTTP Basic with the private API key as username and empty password. GET /v1/files, file details, and uploaded metadata confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is ImageKit.io (New Delhi, India). Dated incident search found no qualifying current unresolved compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
